summary.storyTitle: Story 3: Archive Read and Reopen Surface
summary.implementedScope: Implemented Story 3’s authenticated archive read surface end-to-end: added the Fastify archive HTML/API routes and archive read service, wired a new client-side archive route/state/page that loads durable archive entries without live environment dependence, and added route/rendering coverage for empty, reload, environment-loss, access-control, invalid-query, and degraded-entry cases.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead could not accept the story because 3 acceptance check(s) remain incomplete.

evidence: 005-verify.json identified the unbounded Convex production read as blocking.
008-verify.json reports the finding resolved: `convex/archiveEntries.ts:139-167` applies cursor/index constraints and reads only `limit + 1` rows with `.take(...)`.
008-verify.json reports focused archive tests and `corepack pnpm run green-verify` passed.

changedFiles.reason: Added the bounded archive read service with process access enforcement and INVALID_ARCHIVE_REQUEST validation.
Added the archive HTML shell route and GET archive API route with auth/access/error handling.
Registered the archive read service and archive routes in the Fastify app.
Added the client archive fetcher and archive-specific fallback error parsing.
Extended shared route/app state to support the new process-archive route and archive surface state.
Seeded default archive surface state in the client store.
Added URL parsing and href building for /projects/:projectId/processes/:processId/archive.
Bootstraps the archive route by loading process context plus the durable archive page and resetting route-specific state cleanly.
Routes the shell renderer to the new archive page when the archive surface is active.
Renders archive entries, page state, empty state, and degraded-entry metadata.
Added the user-visible process archive page wrapper with process context and back navigation.
Added Story 3 server coverage for reload, environment loss, access control, invalid query handling, and degraded entries.
Extended client coverage to prove archive entries, empty state, and degraded entry rendering.
